_note: Static schema reference for filtered-discovery.json produced by filter.py. Not read or written by any pipeline component. The real file (gitignored) is overwritten on every filter run.

items._comment: All original raw-discovery fields are preserved verbatim. Two fields are added by filter.py.
items.item_title: Example original headline exactly as it appears in the feed
items.feed_description: Raw HTML from the feed description element.

_schema_notes.source_run_id: The run_id from the source raw-discovery.json — links filtered output back to the ingestion run.
_schema_notes.filtered_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when filter.py ran.
_schema_notes.stale_cutoff_hours: Items published more than this many hours before source_run_id were rejected. Controlled by --stale-hours CLI arg (default 48).
_schema_notes.dropped.stale: Count of items rejected because item_published age exceeded stale_cutoff_hours.
_schema_notes.dropped.url_dedup: Count of items dropped because their canonical_url matched an earlier item in the same run.
_schema_notes.dropped.title_dedup: Count of items dropped because their title fingerprint (first 10 words, lowercased, punctuation stripped) matched an earlier item. Tie-break: Original Reporting preferred over Discovery Only; then earliest item_published.
_schema_notes.canonical_url: Added by filter.py. Normalized form of item_url: lowercase scheme/host, trailing path slash removed, tracking params stripped, fragment dropped. Used for deduplication. item_url is never modified.
_schema_notes.age_hours: Added by filter.py. Hours between item_published and source_run_id, rounded to 2 decimal places. null when item_published was absent or unparseable.
